description.zh: 存储到期后，自动归档保存的天数（可选值：60、90、180、365）。0表示不归档保存。
description.en: The number of days for which data is automatically archived after the storage expires. Valid values: 60, 90, 180, and 365. 0 indicates that the data is not archived.

description.zh: 是否开启免密读的IP地址列表，支持CIDR配置。多个IP之间换行符分隔。
description.en: The IP addresses or CIDR blocks for which password-free read is enabled. Separate multiple IP addresses with line breaks.

description.zh: 是否开启免密写的IP地址列表，支持CIDR配置。多个IP之间换行符分隔。
description.en: The IP addresses or CIDR blocks for which password-free write is enabled. Separate multiple IP addresses with line breaks.
The ID of the Prometheus instance.
Specifies whether to enable password-free read.
Specifies whether to enable password-free write.
Specifies whether to enable access token authentication.

description.zh:
计费方式：
POSTPAY：按指标上报量后付费。
POSTPAY_GB：按指标写入量后付费。
description.en: The billing mode. Valid values: POSTPAY: charges fees based on the amount of reported metric data. POSTPAY_GB: charges fees based on the amount of written metric data.
The ID of the Prometheus resource group.
The data storage duration. Unit: days.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms update-prometheus-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmxyexli20000 --cluster-id vpc-xxx --storage-duration 90 --archive-duration 90 --enable-auth-token true --enable-auth-free-read true --auth-free-read-policy 0.0.0.0/0 --enable-auth-free-write true --auth-free-write-policy 0.0.0.0/0 --payment-type POSTPAY --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
